id: \bYou poor thing. Hurry up and take this.
en: \bYou poor thing. Hurry up and take this.

id: \rIt's very cheap staying here. Though sometimes my home is off at sea by the time I get back.
en: \rIt's very cheap staying here. Though sometimes my home is off at sea by the time I get back.
it: \rStare qui costa pochissimo. Anche se a volte, quando torno, la mia casa è già in mare aperto.

id: \rHave you ever met Mina? She's our daughter.
en: \rHave you ever met Mina? She's our daughter.
it: \rHai mai conosciuto Mina? È nostra figlia.

id: \bAre you interested in staying with us?
en: \bAre you interested in staying with us?

id: \bNo, please just walk into my home.
en: \bNo, please just walk into my home.
it: \bNo, prego, entra pure in casa mia come se niente fosse.

id: \bMina has been going all across the world to improve her art.
en: \bMina has been going all across the world to improve her art.
it: \bMina gira il mondo per migliorare la sua arte.

id: \bI find these all the time when I go swimming. You can have one.
en: \bI find these all the time when I go swimming. You can have one.
it: \bLi trovo sempre quando vado a nuotare. Puoi prenderne uno.
